definitions.gloss: coverage area; communication range; signal range
definitions.explanation: The geographic area within which a wireless device can send and receive signals. Used for mobile phones, radio, Wi-Fi, and other wireless communication.

examples.japanese: {通信圏|つうしんけん}{外|がい}で{電話|でんわ}が{使|つか}えない。
examples.english: The phone doesn't work because it's out of coverage.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{奥|おく}では{通信圏|つうしんけん}に{入|はい}れないことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Deep in the mountains, you often can't get into a coverage area.

examples.japanese: トンネルを{抜|ぬ}けてやっと{通信圏|つうしんけん}に{戻|もど}り、メッセージが{一斉|いっせい}に{届|とど}いた。
examples.english: After leaving the tunnel, I finally got back into coverage and all my messages came through at once.

notes:
A compound of {通信|つうしん} (communication, telecommunications) and {圏|けん} (sphere, zone). Commonly encountered when traveling to remote areas or underground locations where mobile phone signals are weak or absent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通信圏|つうしんけん}{外|がい}: out of range, out of coverage
- {通信圏|つうしんけん}{内|ない}: within range, in coverage
- {通信圏|つうしんけん}に{入|はい}る: to enter a coverage area
- {通信圏|つうしんけん}から{外|はず}れる: to go out of coverage

RELATED WORDS:
- {圏外|けんがい}: out of range — the shorter, more casual term displayed on Japanese phones when there is no signal
- {圏内|けんない}: within range — the opposite of {圏外|けんがい}
- {電波|でんぱ}: radio waves, signal — the physical signal itself
